grafts.name: Adrenal Gland
grafts.text: From round 2, the first graft each round costs 1 less (never below 2).

grafts.name: Stripped Frame
grafts.text: -1 slot (Nerve). Your grafts add 2 less Strain (min 0). +1 attack.

strain.name: Pain Tolerance
strain.text: Overclock self-damage only on even rounds.

strain.name: Burnout
strain.text: When you reject a graft, deal 3 damage to the opponent.

strain.name: Redline
strain.text: Overclocked starts at 7; the Overclock bonus is +1 more damage.

stance.name: Pounce
stance.text: Winning with Aggress adds 2 Strain to the opponent.

stance.name: Feint
stance.text: Once per match, re-pick your stance after a tie (gain 2 Strain, take 3 damage); the opponent keeps theirs.

grafts.name: Spore Sacs
grafts.text: Organ grafts add 1 Strain to the opponent on attach.

grafts.name: Symbiote
grafts.text: Your first graft each match adds only 1 Strain.

grafts.name: Incubator
grafts.text: Toxins cost 1 less if you grafted this round.

strain.name: Contagion
strain.text: The opponent vents 1 less in the Draw phase.

strain.name: Feedback
strain.text: When you reject a graft, the opponent gains 2 Strain.

stance.name: Latch
stance.text: Winning with Adapt adds 1 Strain to the opponent.

stance.name: Mirror
stance.text: Stance tie on an even round: draw 1.

grafts.name: Fortress Frame
grafts.text: +1 slot (Organ B). +2 armor. Organ grafts cost 1 more.

grafts.name: Regenerator
grafts.text: Heal 1 at the Strain check while Stable, every third round.

strain.name: Heat Sink
strain.text: Vent 1 extra on even rounds, and 2 more on rounds you Hold.

strain.name: Pressure Valve
strain.text: Once per match, as a Protocol-speed reaction, vent 2.

strain.name: Hardened
strain.text: Rejection ejects your lowest-Strain graft instead.

stance.name: Unshakable
stance.text: Losing to Adapt halves your armor instead of ignoring it.

evolution.name: Hair Trigger
evolution.text: Evolution conditions x0.75 (rounded up); evolved numeric bonuses -1 (a +2 bonus stays +2).

evolution.name: Late Bloomer
evolution.text: Evolution conditions x1.1 (rounded up); evolved numeric bonuses +1.

evolution.name: Surge
evolution.text: Evolving lowers your Strain to 2 (if it is higher).
